scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “A closed Ricci flow with bounded scalar curvature and finite-time curvature blowup” (preprints/A-closed-Ricci-flow-with-bounded-scalar-curvature-and-finite-time-curvature-blowup-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 351 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 88b1d8270cb2bc5f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are an integer q ≥ 10, a time T > 0, and a smooth Ricci flow g(t), 0 ≤ t < T, on the closed connected manifold M = S2 × Sq+1, with smooth initial metric, such that sup M×[0,T) |Rg(t)| < ∞, lim t↑T max M | Rmg(t) | = ∞. In particular, T is the finite maximal existence time of this flow.
